# Ciqual 2020 XML

These four XML files are from ANSES's Ciqual 2020 nutrition table, distributed under the French **Licence Ouverte / Open Licence**. Source: https://www.data.gouv.fr/datasets/table-de-composition-nutritionnelle-des-aliments-ciqual-2020

The original XML is packed here so the app can initialize a local database without including any personal account data. This dataset is separate from Kizine's MIT-licensed application code.
